newsitem.title: CANADA: Loewen says FTC probes Service deal.
newsitem.headline: Loewen says FTC probes Service deal.

text.p: The Loewen Group Inc said Tuesday the U.S. Federal Trade Commission has contacted its attorneys as part of an investigation into the proposed takeover of Loewen by Service Corp International.
Loewen has rejected Service's US$43 a share offer. Service is widely expected to launch a higher hostile bid.

Loewen said the U.S. agency requested data on all Loewen's funeral homes and cemeteries including "detailed information about regional market overlap between Loewen Group and SCI properties, including any properties in which either company has a financial interest."

Service is the biggest operator of funeral homes and cemeteries in North America and Loewen is the second biggest. Loewen has said anti-trust concerns could derail the deal but Service claims it could surmount any anti-trust hurdles by divesting a limited number of properties.
Florida's attorney general last week began an investigation into the potential impact of the deal in that state.
